TRIMAW-DOODLED.title: Doodled
TRIMAW-DOODLED.description: This card costs {Energy:energyIcons()}, but deals [blue]{DamageReductionPct}%[/blue] less damage and gains [blue]{DamageReductionPct}%[/blue] less block.
TRIMAW-FOCUSED.title: Focused
TRIMAW-FOCUSED.description: This Attack regains all [gold]Aim[/gold] and [gold]Vigor[/gold] it uses.
TRIMAW-GLAZED.title: Glazed
TRIMAW-HYPERFIXATED.title: Hyperfixated
TRIMAW-HYPERFIXATED.description: This card spends ALL Energy and has Replay for each {Energy:energyIcons()} spent.
TRIMAW-POCKETED.title: Pocketed
TRIMAW-POLISHED.title: Polished
TRIMAW-POLISHED.description: This card is free, but its cost increases by {Energy:energyIcons()} whenever played.
TRIMAW-POLISHED.extraCardText: Increase the cost of this card by {Energy:energyIcons()}.
TRIMAW-REALLY_HEAVY.title: Really Heavy
TRIMAW-REALLY_HEAVY.description: [gold]Strength[/gold] and [gold]Vigor[/gold] affect this card an additional time for each [blue]{DamageDivisor:diff()}[/blue] damage it deals.
TRIMAW-REALLY_HOT.title: Really Hot
TRIMAW-REALLY_HOT.description: Whenever this card enters your [gold]Hand[/gold], gain {Amount} [gold]Vigor[/gold], then reduce this amount by 1.
TRIMAW-SKEWERED.title: Skewered
TRIMAW-SKEWERED.description: When played, add a [gold]Dart[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
TRIMAW-SLIMY.title: Slimy
TRIMAW-SPICED.title: Spiced
TRIMAW-XXL.title: XXL
TRIMAW-XXL.description: This card does not [gold]Exhaust[/gold] the next {Amount:plural:time|[blue]{}[/blue] times} played.
